propositions: Review gates need typed execution contracts distinguishing clean execution, failure, cancellation, skipping, budget-shedding, and resumption instead of conflating outcomes as binary success/failure.

A narrow independent discovery submodule under rebar.llm.review_kernel must define immutable plan/result types and a synchronous dependency-aware executor without modifying existing verify/decide/coach modules.
The executor must deterministically shed work in ascending (dependency rank, unit id) order such that the shed set is identical across runs, cascading skipped status to unmet dependents.

A versioned digest-complete checkpoint envelope must identify material, code/ref, effective-policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, dependencies, and namespace version such that only success and content-identical resumed units round-trip as reusable.
When a local unit fails, the executor must retain earlier successes, continue independent later units, and mark dependents as skipped with the missing dependency reason.
Stored trace must normalize outcome metadata and lineage while excluding raw prompts, ticket/context bodies, provider payloads, and secrets; review/review-status result schemas remain unchanged.
